title: Efficient Learning of Structured Fermionic States under General Quadratic Evolution
summary: We prove copy-optimal learning of the full Gaussian orbit of paired magic states on $n$ fermionic modes. The unknown evolution may be any parity-preserving quadratic circuit, including pair creation and annihilation, and each copy is measured once, in a fixed basis, on a single quartic Majorana observable. A nonadaptive learner returns a Gaussian preparation within trace distance $ε$ from $Θ(n^6/ε^2)$ copies at fixed confidence, and no learner in this measurement model, adaptive or not, can do better.
